question: The Members of Parliament Local Area Development (MPLAD) scheme is implemented by which Union Ministry?

options.text: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
Ministry of Social Justice and empowerment

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Members of Parliament Local Area Development (MPLAD) scheme is implemented by the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation** in India.
 
• It was introduced in December 1993, with the aim to enable MPs to recommend developmental work in their constituencies with emphasis on creating durable community assets based on locally felt needs.
 
• Under this scheme, each MP is allocated a specific amount of funds annually to carry out development activities in their respective constituencies.
 
• The MPLAD scheme ensures that the funds are utilized for the developmental projects which primarily focus on the creation of durable assets for community use.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation**

 
 
• This ministry is responsible for the development of the statistical system and coordination of statistical activities in India.
 
• It oversees the implementation of the MPLAD scheme and ensures proper utilization of funds.
 
• The ministry also monitors and evaluates various other government programs and initiatives to ensure their effective implementation.
 
 
 
• **Members of Parliament Local Area Development (MPLAD) scheme**
 
 
• It empowers MPs to recommend works of developmental nature with emphasis on the creation of durable community assets in their constituencies.
 
• The objective of the scheme is to enable MPs to respond to the local needs of their constituencies.
 
• Funds under the MPLAD scheme are released in the form of grants-in-aid directly to the district authorities.
 
• The district authorities are responsible for the overall implementation of the projects under the MPLAD scheme.
 
 
 
• **Other similar government schemes**
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)**: A nationwide plan in India to provide good all-weather road connectivity to unconnected villages.
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)**: A social security measure that aims to guarantee the 'right to work' and ensure livelihood security in rural areas.
 
• **Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana**: A scheme aimed at alleviating urban and rural poverty through skill development and enhancing livelihood opportunities.
